thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager SEV2: spike in streaming disconnects + tool-call parse failures for /v1/stream and /v1/toolcall routes. Detected 202 new disconnects in the last 5m (baseline ~3/min). Auto-escalate to on-call.

Sam (SRE): i'm on it, grabbing initial graphs. Can someone note impacted customers?

Maria (support): Maria here — support flagged 3 paying customers reporting truncated streaming responses and JSON parse errors from our JS SDK. They're on us-east1 and using v2 client.

Sam (SRE): thanks. quick ask: @Leo, can you take on-call? i'm going to pull runtime logs and timeline.

Leo (on-call): taking it. posting timeline as I gather it. pls ping if you need me to flip any routing.

Anya (runtime): i'm watching the proxy and runtime. seeing elevated 502/EOF on ingress. trying to correlate with toolcall parser errors.

Sam (SRE): early facts: ingress (nginx) shows increased 502/connection reset from upstream at 15:02:12 UTC. runtime reports consecutive partial chunks then connection close. SDK clients show "Unexpected end of JSON input".

Sam (SRE): logs snapshot:
```
# ingress logs (cut)
15:01:58 10.0.1.5 "GET /v1/stream?session=abc" 200 0 "-" "sse-client/2.0" upstream_response_time: 0.89
15:02:12 10.0.1.5 "GET /v1/stream?session=def" 502 234 "-" "sse-client/2.0" upstream_response_time: 0.00
15:02:13 10.0.1.5 "POST /v1/toolcall" 200 512 "-" "toolbridge/1.1" request_time: 1.1
15:02:17 10.0.1.5 "POST /v1/toolcall" 200 120 "-" "toolbridge/1.1" request_time: 0.12
```
```
# runtime error snippets
2024-11-07T15:02:12Z runtime ERR streaming: client disconnect EOF session=def conn_id=3456
2024-11-07T15:02:13Z runtime WARN toolcall: incomplete payload, parse error: unexpected '\u0000' at byte 128
2024-11-07T15:02:14Z router INFO fallback: routing request to compat-runtime for session=ghi
```

Sam (SRE): grep commands I used to fetch traces: `kubectl logs -lapp=runtime --since=15m | grep -E "streaming:|toolcall:"` and `kubectl get events -n prod --since=15m`.

Anya (runtime): hypothesis A: transient backpressure in runtime KV/cache layer caused partial flushes then connection close. Hypothesis B: ingress NGinx changed upstream keepalive limits earlier today (deploy) causing abrupt upstream resets for long-lived SSE. Hypothesis C: some clients send unexpected binary frames that break our toolcall JSON parser (older SDK bug).

Leo (on-call): to add — I see a spike in tcp_retries2 on the LB at 15:02 which could fit the keepalive/timeout hypothesis.

Maria (support): customers all on older SDK 2.x (not 3.x) — noted. they show identical stack traces on client: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token < in JSON at position 0` sometimes.

Sam (SRE): immediate mitigation options: 1) enable router-level compat-mode to route 2.x clients to compat-runtime that tolerates partial frames (quick toggle, low-risk), 2) increase ingress upstream keepalive/timeout (config change, needs LB reload), 3) enable server-side buffering to avoid partial chunk exposure (can be toggled per-route but might add latency).

Anya (runtime): i can enable compat-runtime routing flag for affected customer ids now (feature flag). doing a small canary (5%) first.

Leo (on-call): pls do canary and report metrics for error rate and disconnects for the next 3m. I'll standby to roll to 100% if green.

Dev Tools Bot: canary toggle executed by Anya for customer_ids=[CUST-1004,CUST-1011] rollout=5% id=ff-3892

Sam (SRE): monitoring: after canary there was an initial drop in streaming disconnects for those sessions: from 12/min -> 1/min. toolcall parse errors for those customers stopped.

Leo (on-call): great. roll to 100% for all v2 client traffic in us-east1? call it if you agree.

Maria (support): customers reporting immediate improvement in their apps. they can confirm reduced errors. :white_check_mark:

Anya (runtime): rolling to 100% now. executing: `feature-flag-client-compat set --region us-east1 --client-version 2.x --on`

Dev Tools Bot: rollout complete for client-version 2.x region=us-east1 status=success id=ff-3892

Sam (SRE): instrumenting: capturing full timeline and logs to /mnt/incidents/2043216789/logs.tar.gz and created a short incident note in ops.jira/INC-2139.

Leo (on-call): preliminary impact summary: ~3 customers affected, estimated failed streaming sessions ~2.4k over 12 minutes, error class: truncated streaming leading to client JSON parse failures; no data exfiltration. SLA impact: elevated error rate for those endpoints for ~12m.

Anya (runtime): root-cause hypotheses for RCA doc (we'll prioritize):
- H1: ingress keepalive/timeout regression after recent LB config change leading to upstream resets for long-lived SSE connections
- H2: runtime backpressure from a hot key set in KV cache causing drain and abrupt connection close
- H3: incompatible binary frames or control chars from older SDK 2.x producing invalid bytes that our toolcall parser treated as the start of next message

Sam (SRE): evidence mapping in-thread:
- H1: lb tcp_retries2 spike at same minute (supporting) + recent LB diff rolled at 14:58 (supporting)
- H2: runtime heap GC and queue depth increased by ~3x at 15:00 (supporting but not conclusive)
- H3: client user-agent correlation: all failures were 2.x clients (supporting) + parser errors show NUL/unexpected chars in payload (supporting)

Leo (on-call): conclusion for live mitigation: compat-mode mitigated customer impact quickly. next actions to close incident:
1) Postmortem doc + timeline (owner: Sam, due: +24h)
2) LB config rollback or targeted keepalive bump (owner: Eng-Infra, contact: @Nina) — immediate fix or revert (high priority)
3) Runtime patch: harden toolcall parser to ignore leading control chars and fail gracefully (owner: Anya, due: +72h)
4) Integration test: add long-lived SSE soak tests for ingress/runtime (owner: Eng-Tests, due: +1w)
5) Customer follow-up notes from Support (owner: Maria, due: +2h)

Maria (support): I'll send a templated note and offer a follow-up call. customers want confirmation when root cause is fixed.

Sam (SRE): collecting artifacts: k8s events, ingress diffs, runtime GC traces, LB tcp stats. attaching to postmortem.

Anya (runtime): quick repro attempt steps (for triage):
```
# simulate streaming client with keepalive gap
python simulate_sse.py --host api.redwood.example --duration 300 --burst 50 --client-version 2.0
# check runtime logs
kubectl logs deploy/runtime -c runtime --since=30m | grep "incomplete payload\|client disconnect"
```

Leo (on-call): flagging owners. i'm going to escalate LB change to eng-infra. cc @Nina. if infra agrees, we can either rollback LB diff or bump keepalive to 90s.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by teams. Severity remains SEV2 until postmortem completed or mitigations confirmed stable for 24h.

Sam (SRE): final note before handoff: mitigated customer-visible errors by routing 2.x clients to compat-runtime. still unknown if primary root cause is ingress config vs runtime backpressure vs SDK bytes. we'll capture more logs for RCA. handing off to postmortem.

Leo (on-call): handing off to Sam for postmortem. i'll monitor overnight in case of regression. :eyes:

Maria (support): closing support loop for impacted customers and scheduling follow-ups.

Anya (runtime): creating a patch branch for parser hardening now. linking ticket ENG-5342 to postmortem.

Sam (SRE): thank you everyone — closing live incident thread. postmortem draft will be shared in this channel when ready. :white_check_mark:
